description: Use for 'what changed recently / any new laws in X' — e.g. 'new crypto regulation in Portugal 2026', 'recent visa rule changes Thailand', 'what changed in Paraguay immigration law this year'. Returns legal and regulatory change records, sorted newest first. Filter by `country` (single) or `countries` (array, up to 50), optional `categories` (array), and either a `from_date`/`to_date` range or a `month`/`year` pair (mutually exclusive). Supports `limit` (1–100) and `offset` for pagination. Each record carries title, summary, category, date and sources; pass `include_full_content: true` only when the full text is needed.

categories.description: Exact category names to filter on, e.g. ['Corporate Taxation']. Each result's `category` field shows the valid values.

countries.description: Several countries to filter on (up to 50), same formats as `country`.

country.description: Single country to filter on: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'PT' or 'Portugal'.

from_date.description: Start of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `to_date`.

include_full_content.description: Set true to include each record's full text (several thousand characters each). Default false returns title, summary and sources only.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100, default 20).

month.description: Calendar month 1-12. Must be given together with `year`.

offset.description: Records to skip, for paging. Use the response's `next_offset`.

to_date.description: End of a date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `from_date`.

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. 2026. Must be given together with `month`.

name: get_legal_changes
title: Get recent legal changes
